handoff.project: Forest Run is a native Kotlin Android landscape endless runner using SurfaceView/Canvas with persistent world state plus candidate-bound evidence/release tooling.
handoff.what_exists: The master map and linked ledgers use exact main 1d1a73451ad59e088d4117216d07162628913ff8 as the source baseline, with a later uncommitted test/driver/docs delta documented by EVID-080. The 1,007-path inventory has 951 fully statically inspected, 17 partial, 36 documented and 3 excluded records; 6,137 declarations span 256 production paths; 389 source test contracts remain inventoried. Full source-payload Python/JVM suites (1,387/1,297), exact-main focused tests (113 Python/129 JVM/UI plus 23 movement-bound/physics), lint/package, and exact-main hosted API 35 validation passed (EVID-072/EVID-076/EVID-078/EVID-079). All 29 runtime sprite sheets received static visual review (EVID-077). No additional source defect was established.
